entities.summary: Central Asian Revolt, a transformative movement in Kazakhstan (1870–1917). Emerged from Colonial Conquest and Resistance and Kenesary Khan leads the last major Kazakh uprising against Russian rule. Catalyzed Settler Colonialism and 1916 Revolt and Stolypin.
